capabilities: Synchronize a vault across desktop and mobile through a private Cloudflare R2 bucket
Encrypt file contents, filenames, paths, and sync history end-to-end before upload
Show a plan of pending changes and apply the sync only after user confirmation
Merge safe text changes and keep both versions on unsafe conflicts
Pair new devices with a reusable secret pairing code
extras: Warns against running it alongside any other sync solution on the same vault; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; sync history is informational only and cannot restore older revisions; README notes plugin settings including credentials are stored in plaintext data.json.
intentEvidence: If you want an Obsidian Sync alternative with storage in your own Cloudflare account, but do not want to run a self-hosted server
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync uses the developer's service, and DIY sync options either rely on someone else's backend or require running a self-hosted server.

relations.evidence: Is this the official Obsidian Sync service? No. Isomite is an independent community plugin and is not affiliated

requires.name: Cloudflare account with an R2 bucket and API token
Cloudflare R2 storage usage and billing

summary: Encrypted vault-sync plugin that syncs desktop and mobile through the user's own private Cloudflare R2 bucket with confirmation before every sync.
